fusions.name: Stoop
fusions.desc: Dives at a target up to 7 tiles away and drives the tines down for 14 piercing damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Soaring Cast
fusions.desc: Throws the polearm in a gliding arc that reaches 50% further, dealing 28 piercing damage to the first enemy it meets. It ignores the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Vault Aloft
fusions.desc: Vaults off the haft and glides 5 tiles forward, then moves 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: On the Wing
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
